findings_addressed.oracle: Three independent gates replace the tautological injected-data pattern. Gate 1: set_watchpoint raises ToolError with exact tool_name=="x64dbg", x64dbg_error_code=="plugin_unavailable", and command=="wp_set" (not a loose regex). Gate 2: get_watchpoints() returns an empty list after a failed set, proving set_watchpoint does not insert before the pipe command succeeds. Gate 3: a transport-boundary stub pipe client returns a controlled wp_list with one duplicate address (0x5678) and one new address (0xABCD, size=2, type="read"); get_watchpoints() must return exactly 2 entries (dedup works), the new entry must have size==2 (field mapping correct), watch_type=="read" (not defaulted), and hit_count==3.
documented_mutations: In _send_pipe_command: change '"command": command' to '"command": "watchpoint_set"' → Gate 1 command assertion fails.
In set_watchpoint: move _watchpoints[wp_id]=… before await _send_pipe_command(…) → Gate 2 len==0 assertion fails.
In get_watchpoints pipe branch: remove the 'if not existing' deduplication guard → Gate 3 len(wps)==2 fails (returns 3).
In get_watchpoints pipe branch: replace 'raw_wp_type if isinstance(raw_wp_type, str) else "write"' with literal "write" → Gate 3 watch_type=="read" fails.
In get_watchpoints pipe branch: replace 'raw_size if isinstance(raw_size, int) else 1' with literal 1 → Gate 3 size==2 fails.

notes: Transport-boundary injection via setattr(bridge, '_pipe_client', stub) avoids type suppressions and private-access warnings. The stub implements only is_connected and send_command, mirroring the NamedPipeClient interface used by _send_pipe_command. The watchpoints property (public getter) is used to pre-load the internal dict, avoiding direct private-attribute access. FIX (2026-06-22): the seeded internal watchpoint is inserted at id 1, so the test now also sets bridge.next_wp_id = 2 to mirror the post-set_watchpoint invariant (every tracked id < next_wp_id). Without it, get_watchpoints assigned the new pipe watchpoint the colliding id 1 and overwrote the seeded entry, yielding 1 instead of 2 (test-setup bug, not a production defect - set_watchpoint always increments next_wp_id). Verified GREEN in sandbox.
